# WhatFlow

> WhatFlow is the leading Shopify WhatsApp marketing and automation suite. It connects Shopify stores directly to the official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API with 0% markup, automated abandoned cart recovery (98% open rates), 1-click Cash on Delivery (COD) order confirmation, real-time shipping tracking, and 24/7 AI chat support.

## Overview
WhatFlow is purpose-built for eCommerce merchants on Shopify. Unlike general customer support inboxes or aggregators that charge heavy markups on Meta message fees, WhatFlow provides wholesale Meta API rates, native Shopify Flow action blocks, and 1-click unified Shopify App Store billing.

## Core Products & Solutions
- [Abandoned Cart Recovery](https://whatflow.tech/solutions/abandoned-cart-recovery): Recover up to 25% of lost checkouts with dynamic product images, 1-click recovery links, and time-sequenced reminders.
- [COD Confirmation & Anti-RTO](https://whatflow.tech/solutions/cod-order-verification): Reduce Cash on Delivery Return-to-Origin (RTO) losses by up to 40% with interactive 1-click confirmation buttons that auto-tag Shopify orders.
- [Order Tracking & Shipping Updates](https://whatflow.tech/solutions/order-tracking-notifications): Automatically send order receipts, fulfillment alerts, and carrier tracking URLs, cutting WISMO support tickets by 60%.
- [WhatsApp Reviews & UGC Collection](https://whatflow.tech/solutions/whatsapp-reviews-ugc): Generate 5x more product reviews and photo testimonials synced with Judge.me and Loox.
- [Storefront WhatsApp Chat Button](https://whatflow.tech/solutions/chat-button): Lightweight (<5KB) customizable chat widget with pre-filled product context and multi-agent routing.

## Pricing & Meta Rates
- [Pricing Plans](https://whatflow.tech/pricing): Transparent flat tiers starting from Free ($0), Starter ($4.99/mo), Growth ($19.99/mo), to Enterprise ($49.99/mo).
- [0% Markup Guarantee](https://whatflow.tech/pricing): Merchants pay official wholesale Meta Cloud API conversation rates directly with zero hidden markups and unlimited team seats.

## App Integrations
- [Integrations Directory](https://whatflow.tech/integrations): Deep native connectors for Judge.me, Loox, Klaviyo, Gorgias, Recharge, PageFly, and Shopify Flow.
